WITH account_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    account.account_id,
    district.A3 as region,
    AVG(trans.amount) as account_avg
  FROM account
  JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
  JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
  GROUP BY account.account_id, district.A3
),
region_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    AVG(account_avg) as region_avg
  FROM account_avgs
  GROUP BY region
),
all_region_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(region_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM region_avgs
)
SELECT 
  ra.region,
  ra.region_avg,
  ra.region_avg - ara.overall_avg as exceeds,
  ra.region_avg / ara.overall_avg as ratio
FROM region_avgs ra
CROSS JOIN all_region_avg ara
WHERE ra.region_avg > ara.overall_avg
ORDER BY ra.region
